description: This Java class 'DetachedSensor' provides a GUI component for displaying and interacting with sensor data, including mock voltage controls, within a larger application. It manages sensor display, configuration, and user interactions.

classes.name: DetachedSensor
classes.description: A GUI component for displaying and mocking sensor data, with configuration persistence.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Initializes the GUI components and adds the sensor gauge and mock controls.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the sensor window at the location of a mouse event.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Updates the sensor being displayed and refreshes the mock control panel.

methods.name: showMockControl
methods.description: Displays mock voltage slider if the sensor is mockable and in stimulation mode.

methods.name: isMockable
methods.description: Checks if the current sensor can be mocked based on predefined list and mode.

methods.name: createMockVoltageSlider
methods.description: Creates a slider component to mock sensor voltage values.

methods.name: saveConfig
methods.description: Saves the current sensor configuration and window position to a node.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a DetachedSensor instance from a configuration node and displays it.
